verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires green accents as part of the machine's rendered enclosure appearance.
The client explicitly adds beige as the machine body color; this does not conflict with or obsolete the existing green-accent specification.
The client requires the newly discussed support base to match the reference's beige shade and font color, extending the physical color treatment to that component.

The client explicitly requires reproduction of the rendering colors for the machine and its separate base, establishing the renderings as the color reference without invalidating the existing beige and green details.
